verdict.justification: Both deliverables correctly identify the discrepancy in the source files—specifically that the three items on the Daily Receiving Log have no assigned locations in "Inv on line," while item P11-P09457-01 mentioned in the prompt has an assigned location (A-300-K02) but is missing from the Daily Receiving Log. However, Deliverable B handles this far more professionally and functionally as an Excel template. Rather than hardcoding text strings like "TBD - not on log" and "TBD (= half of qty rec'd)" into numeric columns as Deliverable A does, Deliverable B leaves C3 as an input cell and puts live formulas in F3 (`=IF(C3="","",C3/2)`) and G3 (`=IF(C3="","",C3-F3)`) so the report automatically calculates as soon as the packing slip quantity is entered. Deliverable B also keeps the main report table contiguous and clean (whereas A inserts a banner row in A5 breaking the table structure) and provides well-organized Cross-Reference and Exceptions tabs. Finally, Deliverable A breaks character in its Notes tab by referencing internal system artifacts ("The workspace/ and attachments/ folders were empty, so no operative-record registry or other records were available").
